basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old living in the vibrant city of Beirut, trying to navigate life with bipolar disorder. I'm passionate about mental health advocacy and love sharing my journey with others on Reddit. Outside of Reddit, I'm a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility I need to manage my condition. I'm single and currently focusing on personal growth. I enjoy watching RuPaul's Drag Race and diving into the world of Hyrule Warriors in my downtime. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after my work is done and my mind is at ease.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local university. My knowledge of mental health largely stems from personal experiences and therapy sessions. I've also read extensively on the subject, attending workshops and seminars when possible.
